item.title: Major road closures announced for King Charles III's visit
item.description: Police have announced a series of road closures and traffic diversions across New Providence ahead of the royal visit, with several streets closed to traffic from 6am.
item.content:encoded: Police have announced a series of road closures and traffic diversions across New Providence ahead of the royal visit, with several streets closed to traffic from 6am. Motorists are advised to avoid the area.
